questions.question: What did the LORD tell the Israelites at Mount Horeb about their time at the mountain?

answers.text: You have stayed at this mountain long enough
Build an altar to Me on this mountain
Stay at this mountain for one more year

questions.question: Moses reminded Israel that the LORD swore to give them a land. Which three fathers did He make that promise to?
When Moses could not carry the troubles and disputes of all Israel by himself, what did he tell the people to do?

answers.text: Choose wise men from each tribe
Cast lots for one new leader
Settle every dispute on their own
